i started looking at how to put the time so i implemented something similiar to what i saw other people doing and so i started doing it myself and it worked... i had this bug btw all on my end that i didnt update the text and it was stuck drawing in loop here :
![Screenshot 2026-11-01 122913](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/HeUpI1b79fx60z96XIA2h1FK5KC4iAKr/44fde31994520c003700a52f897e21bd8a15ac9c6ff05ed7d3171f745e3c76da.png)

so i tought that i drew once in the loop and then update the text and so i did.. i did it first with the time..
it works by declaring the old time and old date and then saving them as chars and in loop if the time is different than old time to update the text instead of redrawing and instead of updating every loop i just check a value.
